Three-Point

  1. Five racks, five balls each. You have 50 seconds, and the clock starts with your first shot.
  2. Hold to fill the power bar; it rises and falls. Let go while it is in the green zone. Use a finger, the mouse or space.
  3. Let go too early and the shot falls short; too late and it clangs off the back rim.
  4. Each basket is 1 point. The last, striped ball on each rack is the money ball, worth 2. The maximum is 30.
